files.title: File:Pisar-Kastanek farmstead from WNW 1.JPG
files.author: Ammodramus
files.caption: Frank Pisar farmstead, located about 2 1/2 miles south of Pleasant Hill  in central Saline County, Nebraska.  View is from the west-northwest.  Note the pile of stone and wood rubble to the right of the 1950s frame house; this may represent the remains of an 1877 stone house.
